full_judgment: 4. The Government on the promulgation of President Order No. 98/72 and pursuant to that order Hazari Lal Sarnaker submitted the statement of land with defendant No.3 and exercised his option to retain 33.24 decimals of land of khas land from plot No.290 at Mouza Beel Kazla and he was possessing the same. That Misc. Case No. 16 of 1973 was assigned to the statement in the office of the defendant No.3 and Hazari Lal Sawrnaker was allotted 33.24 decimals of land from plot No. 29() as per his choice. While in such possession Hazarilal Swarnaker by 2 kabalas dated 22.7.77, by 2 kabalas dated 21.7.77, by 2 kabalas dated 19.7.77 by one kabala dated 11.7.77 by one kabala dated 13.7.77 and by another kabala dated 3.9.77 transferred the suit land measuring 33.24 decimals of land along with another .14 decimals of land to the plaintiff at total consideration of Tk. 3,00,000/- and delivered possession of the suit land to the plaintiff.
